strict_success: exactly two predictions; one-to-one assignment; both position errors <= min(0.10 m, actual nominal separation/3)
sensitivity_conditions: d <= 0.30 m in every direction; also transverse 0.50 <= d <= 1.00 m
interpretation: Fixed numerical settings; one clean sequence per geometry; Monte Carlo repeats noise, not people or environments. Report conditional discrete tested separation thresholds separately by direction and model. No theoretical lower bound or measured resolving capability.
